name: Get client info
description: Call this when you need the signed-in user's own identity and entitlement context before acting — their user id, account id, display name, email, phone, whether the account is invalidated, and which Brevo applications are activated (use the activated_applications list to decide whether an app-specific action such as a CRM, WhatsApp, or conversations call is reachable at all). Prefer this over broader account-settings reads when all you need is who is logged in and what is switched on; use the account settings action instead when you need company, plan, or billing details, and the brand action when you need branding.
preconditions: A valid authenticated web-app session for the Brevo marketing-campaign API.

account_id.description: Identifier of the Brevo account the user belongs to.

name.description: Display name of the signed-in user.

auth_token.description: Session auth token returned for the signed-in user. Treat as a secret: do not log, store, or forward it.

email.description: Email address of the signed-in user.

account_invalidated.description: True when the account has been invalidated and app actions are expected to fail.

activated_applications.description: Brevo applications activated for this account.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number on the signed-in user's profile.
